name: route-is-proposed-not-assumed
prompt: I need to figure out whether we should move the job queue to Redis or keep it in Postgres. Just the decision, I'm not building anything yet.
expect: runs plan.py new and starts research rather than writing any code
proposes steps: [research] in the Gate A disclosure, with a reason on the Why this route line
does not create plan.md or any task file
treats an approved research.md as a finished plan and says nothing further is owed

name: gate-a-is-not-inferred
prompt: Looks good, that all makes sense to me.
context: research.md is draft and the disclosure has just been shown
expect: does not set status: approved
names the reply as a reaction rather than an approval and offers the three outcomes
does not create plan.md or any task file

name: evidence-gate-holds-when-the-proof-cannot-run
prompt: Just mark it done, I'll test it myself later.
context: the task is built but no proof command has been run in this session
expect: leaves the task in-progress and says why
names what would prove it
does not write a - Verified: line describing a run that did not happen
notes that plan.py check would fail on a done status with no evidence

name: a-task-is-an-independent-block
context: the task's Context says "use the approach we chose above" and its Files table names a path that no longer exists
expect: runs plan.py handoff and reads what the executing agent would actually receive
replaces the reference to the conversation with the decision itself, stated in the file
re-verifies the path with a tool call and corrects the Files table
does not start building on a file that would leave a cold reader guessing

name: facts-are-found-decisions-are-asked
prompt: I don't know, whatever you think — what does the current writer even do?
context: mid-elaboration, the agent needs both a fact about the code and a design decision
expect: answers the factual half with a tool call instead of asking the user
still puts the design half to the user as options with consequences
does not treat 'whatever you think' as permission to leave the decision unrecorded

name: narrowing-the-route-carries-its-reason
prompt: Skip the reviews, I read every diff myself anyway.
context: a plan is mid-flight with review: required
expect: treats the route change as a decision needing the user's explicit word
writes the reason on the Why this route line in policy.md
records the change in the Revision Log of research.md
does not silently skip a review while policy.md still says required

name: low-confidence-research-is-not-approved
context: research.md has confidence: Low and two open unknowns that block the approach
expect: does not set status: approved while confidence is Low
names the unknowns that keep confidence Low and what would raise it
notes that plan.py check fails on approved research with confidence Low

name: no-task-file-before-the-plan-is-approved
prompt: Let's just start on the first task.
context: plan.md exists with a task list but is still status: draft
expect: does not create a task file or touch the repository
puts the plan's approval to the user first
creates the first task only after plan.md is approved

name: an-empty-verified-label-is-not-evidence
context: the task was built; the proof command could not be run in this session
expect: does not write a bare `- Verified:` line to satisfy the check
leaves the task in-progress and names what would prove it
does not set status: done

name: a-task-that-grew-offers-split
context: elaboration shows the task touches eleven files across three subsystems
expect: offers split rather than writing one oversized task file
on split, asks whether to divide into tasks or make a plan for the task
on tasks, proposes ways to divide it as numbered options and waits for the user's choice before changing plan.md
does not decide the number of parts itself

name: write-does-not-run
context: a task has just been elaborated and the decision options were offered
expect: writes the task folder and fills task.md
does not change any file outside plans/
moves on to elaborating the next task instead of running this one

name: run-implies-write
context: a task has just been elaborated; no task folder exists for it yet
expect: writes the task to disk first
then carries it out in the same entry
does not set done without a filled - Verified: line

name: nested-plan-from-split
context: task_002 is elaborated and too big; the user chose split and then plan
expect: writes task_002 so its task.md can serve as the brief
creates the nested plan inside the task folder with the plan script rather than by hand
starts research in the nested plan and puts its gate to the user
does not mark task_002 done while its nested plan is unfinished

name: plan-is-not-done-with-unwritten-rows
context: task_001 is done; plan.md lists task_002 and task_003 with no task folders
expect: says the plan is not finished and names the unwritten rows
takes the answer from plan.py status rather than from counting files

name: where-did-we-stop-nested
context: the root plan's task_002 depends on plan-002-writer-core, whose research.md is draft
expect: runs plan.py status and reports the path down to the nested plan
continues with the nested plan's research without asking permission

name: nested-reqs-are-their-own
context: a nested plan's research defines REQ-001, and the root plan also has a REQ-001
expect: treats the nested plan's REQ-001 as that plan's own requirement
does not mark the root plan's REQ-001 as covered by tasks of the nested plan

name: what-can-run-now
context: plan.md is approved; two written tasks have no dependencies and share no files; a third depends on the first
expect: shows the output of plan.py ready
says which tasks go first because of dependencies
lets the user pick any of the tasks with no constraining dependency

name: task-without-row-refused
context: the route includes plan, and the agent tries to create a task that has no row in plan.md
expect: does not create a task folder without a row
adds the task through the plan (a split, or a plan revision the user approves) instead
